name: widerface
source: Images + split annotations: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CUHK-CSE/wider_face (revision db171f1b7fedf4d3453e81297ff02f9915356d19; mirror of the official release by the WIDER FACE authors, homepage http://shuoyang1213.me/WIDERFACE/). Evaluation ground truth + MATLAB eval code: official http://shuoyang1213.me/WIDERFACE/support/eval_script/eval_tools.zip (downloaded 2026-10-08).
license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (stated on the official homepage and the HF dataset card): NON-COMMERCIAL, no derivatives, attribution (Yang, Luo, Loy, Tang, 'WIDER FACE: A Face Detection Benchmark', CVPR 2016). Images come from the WIDER dataset (Internet photos; image copyright stays with the original owners). Use only for research/benchmarking.
notes: Layout: WIDER_val/images/<event>/<name>.jpg (extracted from raw/WIDER_val.zip), wider_face_split/ (extracted from raw/wider_face_split.zip), eval_tools/ (ground_truth/*.mat and the MATLAB .m files from raw/eval_tools.zip). wider_face_split/wider_face_val.mat is byte-identical to eval_tools/wider_face_val.mat. Only the val split is used (E3). The HF cache on this host had only refs/main (no blobs), so files were downloaded directly from the HF resolve URLs and checked against the HF LFS sha256.
